titulo: Saka's hat trick lifts England past Mbappé, France 6-4 in wild World Cup 3rd-place game
cuerpo: Bukayo Saka scored three goals to lead England to a 6-4 win over France for third place in the World Cup, while Kylian Mbappe surpassed Lionel Messi's career World Cup scoring record and took the lead in the Golden Boot race with a pair of second-half goals on Saturday.
